Theorem
[Fenchel--Nielsen coordinates] 1. Theorem 5.3.5\group Teichmuller theorySource: thurston:page-0101, thurston:page-0102, thurston:page-0103, thurston:page-0104 For a closed genus-$g$ surface, $\mathcal T(M)\cong \R ^{6g-6}$, with coordinates $(\log l_i,\tau _i)_{i=1}^{3g-3}$ consisting of lengths and real twist parameters along a pants decomposition. A full twist changes the marked point even when it preserves the unmarked isometry class.
Proof

\sketch Cut along $3g-3$ geodesics into $2g-2$ pants, assign the three length coordinates on each piece, and glue matching boundaries with one real twist per interior curve. The Euler characteristic count gives the number of curves.

□
